details: The European Central Bank's Governing Council decided on July 23, 2026, to keep its three key interest rates unchanged. The deposit rate remains at 2.25%, the main refinancing operations rate at 2.4%, and the marginal lending facility rate at 2.65%. The decision reflects ongoing uncertainty regarding energy prices and their full inflationary impact, with the ECB committed to a data-dependent approach to ensure inflation stabilizes at its 2% target in the medium term.
sourceUrl: https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/pr/date/2026/html/index.en.html (Look for the press release dated July 23, 2026)
title: ECB Keeps Key Interest Rates Unchanged on July 23rd

details: The cryptocurrency market is closely monitoring a packed U.S. regulatory calendar this week, which includes a House Financial Services subcommittee hearing on FinCEN oversight (July 21), the OCC's public comment deadline for GENIUS Act stablecoin regulations (July 24), and the CFTC's deadline for feedback on 24/7 Bitcoin perpetual futures trading (July 27). These regulatory developments, alongside macroeconomic factors like the ECB's rate decision, are expected to influence digital asset markets.
title: US Crypto Regulation & Macro Events Set to Shape This Week's Market
